title: Foundr
tagline: Full-stack finance tracker for solo founders
description: A live, deployed finance-tracking web app that turns manual records into clear metrics — burn rate, runway, ROI, and margins. Decoupled architecture: a static TypeScript/Lit landing frontend on Vercel and an independent Node.js/Express waitlist API on Render, backed by MongoDB Atlas.

title: Sigma DogCare
tagline: UX research + React Native dog-care app
description: User research and stakeholder interviews defined requirements for a dual-interface mobile app. Built a functional React Native prototype covering authentication, booking management, real-time tracking, and payment flows.

title: Pokédex
description: Architected a multi-table relational database and wrote complex SQL queries managing inter-table relationships and aggregate reporting, replicated across MySQL Workbench and MongoDB.

title: Large-Scale Data Analysis
description: Analysed real-world datasets in Jupyter Notebooks using KNN classification and regression, using Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib for wrangling, statistical analysis, and visualisation.

title: Veritree
description: Full Business Model Canvas analysis of an AI-powered enterprise, including stakeholder mapping and adoption analysis using the UTAUT framework and EU AI Act risk classification.
